superseded.reason: Stopped before a decision: offline_reproduction failed because one scripted trace differed under CPU load. The span code labelled any wait of 1 ms or more before a model call as provider pacing (queue.reason), and scripted runs, which have no pacing, sometimes took that long to resume while the Tier 2 run and an image build were running. Fixed in src/observability/run-spans.ts (the label needs real pacing) with a test; a new candidate was cut. The Tier 2 attempt for this candidate (label release-75e4e3ddce94 in evidence/release-gate-ledger.json) was stopped after about 20 minutes, before any result.
